(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a __thermally conductive epoxy-based__ binder; and a solvent.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an __electronic component selected from the group consisting of a silicon chip and a microelectronic component surface__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface __such that the binder remains thermally conductive and cohesive over the component surface__. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 9: A composition comprising cavity generating particles, a __thermally conductive epoxy-based__ binder, and a carrier wherein the particle to binder ratio being about 1 gram to 0.5-0.8 grams and the carrier being about 10 ml per gram of particles.

(Currently Amended) Claim 10: The composition of claim 9, wherein the carrier is selected from the group comprising __ethyl alcohol, isopropyl alcohol, acetone, methylethyl ketone, or fluorocarbon solvents__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 12: The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are selected from the group comprising nickel, copper, aluminum, __and alloys thereof__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 16: A composition of matter comprising carrier, __thermally conductive epoxy-based__ binder, and cavity generating particles, wherein said composition of matter contains, in relative proportion: about 10 ml carrier; about 0.5 to 0.8 grams binder; and about 1 gram of cavity generating particles.
